{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Filter to completed orders
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed)}')

# Step 2: Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
completed['revenue_float'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Step 3: Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed[completed['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')
completed_clean = completed[completed['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Step 4: Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
